metrics.description: Share of attempted cases whose parser/component produced a nonempty typed artifact without a parse or empty-output failure.
Share of attempted cases whose output validated as the measured canonical IR (compiler) or whose reconstruction recompiled to a typed IR (decompiler).
Exact rule-list equality after the measured canonical sort. Compiler compares gold vs L1; decompiler compares L1 vs L2.
Canonical IR CID equality on the measured payload. Distinct from exact only when a non-canonical encoding is retained.
Shape-only AST agreement: rule count, modality node types, and facet arities, ignoring atom strings.
Labeled actor/action/object/qualifier edge-set agreement for the seven-facet rule graph.
Share of nonempty rule fields grounded by a valid half-open source-map span inside the source text. Source-withheld decompilation has no span channel.
Mean weighted assignment semantic score from the frozen round-trip metric. Not a substitute for proof or exact match.
Independent formal-proof replay on paired obligations. Reported unsupported unless a checked proof trace exists.
Disclosed unsupported-construct count per attempted case. This is a disclosure tally, not a quality score, and absence of a disclosure channel is not recorded as zero.
Wall-clock seconds for one isolated surface call.
